mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over 20 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over 5 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over 60 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over 20 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) is growing, it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth does not lead to a statistically significant positive return over 60 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months does not lead to a statistically significant positive return over 20 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) are also increasing, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS growth
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS growth does not lead to a statistically significant positive return over 20 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over 5 trading days in > 60% of triggered instances.
